ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a layer of horizontal thin film, and the thin-film region is labeled n_f; the upper medium is labeled n_1 < n_f, and the lower medium is labeled n_2 < n_f. A beam of light labeled Light is normally incident on the upper surface of the thin film along a vertically downward arrow. Reasoning: Since the light enters the higher-refractive-index thin film from the upper lower-refractive-index medium, the light reflected at the upper surface undergoes a π phase shift; while the light reaching the lower surface is reflected from the higher-refractive-index thin film toward the lower-refractive-index medium, and does not undergo a π phase shift. The two reflected beams also differ by the phase of round-trip propagation inside the thin film, corresponding to a path length of 2t. The problem gives the wavelength inside the thin film as λ, so the propagation phase corresponds to 2t/λ wavelengths. To make the reflected light have maximum constructive interference, in the case where there is already one π phase shift, the smallest nonzero thickness needs to make the round-trip propagation path 2t = λ/2, therefore t = λ/4. More generally, t = (2m+1)λ/4; the minimum thickness is λ/4.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是一层薄膜夹在上下两种介质之间，上方标出 n1 < nf，下方标出 n2 < nf，并画出一束光垂直射向薄膜。再推理：由图可知光从低折射率入射到高折射率薄膜时，顶界面反射会产生半波损失（π 相移），而底界面从高到低反射不产生相移。题干又给出膜内波长为 λ、且为正入射，所以两束反射光的相位差 = 膜内往返传播带来的相位 + 这一次 π 相移。要让反射光与入射光达到最大构造干涉，总相位差需为 2π 的整数倍，于是最小非零厚度满足往返光程 2t = λ/2，从而 t = λ/4。

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图里显示光垂直照到一层高折射率薄膜上，薄膜上下两侧介质的折射率都低于薄膜本身。再推理：这意味着两次主要反射中只有一次会翻相，所以可以用“四分之一波长膜”的直观法来判断。为了让反射回来的两束光相长，膜内往返多出的几何路程 2t 必须提供半个波长的传播相位，正好补偿那一次 π 相移；因此需要 2t = λ/2，得到 t = λ/4。也可以把它看成薄膜作为 quarter-wave transformer：膜厚为 λ/4 时，第二束反射光比第一束多走半个波长，和单次反射翻相配合后实现最强反射。
